verdict.rationale: Parsec's pricing page lists "Virtual monitors" among its professional features, so the host can create virtual displays. However, the evidence is a single bare feature-list entry with no description. It does not show that a streamed window keeps rendering when covered, or that the machine can run headless without a physical monitor. Missing for 10: documentation that virtual monitors enable headless hosting, evidence that content keeps rendering when occluded, plan and platform details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless
